title: Technomancy: Cataclysm
description: A Forge 1.20.1 modpack combining advanced technology, magic, and survival in a dangerous world.
body:
🌌 Technomancy: Cataclysm

Technomancy: Cataclysm is a high-intensity Minecraft modpack that fuses advanced technology with arcane magic in a world on the brink of destruction.

Harness nuclear power, build massive industrial systems, and explore futuristic machinery — or dive into ancient magic, forbidden rituals, and supernatural abilities. The balance between science and sorcery is fragile… and the consequences are catastrophic.

⚙️ Core Features
🔧 Advanced Technology
Complex machinery, automation, and energy systems
Nuclear reactors and high-risk power generation
Industrial-scale production chains
🔮 Magic & Origins
Unique races and abilities (Origins-based gameplay)
Magical artifacts, spells, and progression
Hybrid tech-magic builds
🌍 Dynamic World
Enhanced world generation
Dangerous environments and survival challenges
Exploration with meaningful rewards
⚔️ Combat & Progression
Improved combat mechanics
Bosses, abilities, and scaling difficulty
Multiple playstyles: engineer, mage, hybrid
💥 The Cataclysm

Power comes at a cost.

Unstable energy, forbidden magic, and experimental technology can reshape the world — or destroy it. Every decision matters.

Will you control the chaos… or become part of it?

🧠 Recommended For
Players who enjoy tech + magic combined
Fans of hardcore progression
Builders, engineers, and explorers
People who like powerful but risky gameplay
⚠️ Notes
Requires Forge 1.20.1
Some features may be resource-intensive
Designed for both singleplayer and multiplayer servers
